title: Lov om ophævelse af lov om afgift ved overdragelse af aktier m.v. (L 33, 1998-99)
publication_time_basis: date of Lov nr. 909 af 16. december 1998, printed in the official Folketingstidende record (adopted at third reading 15 December 1998)
verification_notes: Repeals the share transfer duty (aktieafgiftsloven) for transfers from 1 October 1999. That no transfer duty was reintroduced by March 2025 is not shown by this document and is an assumption.
